lines: Black water wells up through the peat. It is warm, like something breathed into it.

sign: Under Driftwick the bog spins slowly. The rafts follow it. So does everything that falls off them.
position_broker: Lucan: I sell tomorrow's position of every raft. Corran sells me tomorrow's position of the town. Everyone profits except the people on it.
position_broker_intro: Lucan: Your position tomorrow: horizontal. Let me show you.

lines: Tomorrow's position of Driftwick costs a hundred. Yours, tonight, costs everything. Pick a raft.
Corran: The bog has stopped spinning. Driftwick will stay put. Do you know what a town that stays put is worth? Nothing.
Corran: Ashby cut your anchor and bet against you. I took the other side of the bet. You're welcome.

corran_intro: Tomorrow's position of Driftwick costs a hundred. Yours, tonight, costs everything. Pick a raft.
corran_defeat: Fine, the Rift is yours. The town drifts on without it. I already sold where it lands.
